site.name: Rambler Mine
overview: Rambler Mine is a documented historic tungsten property in Boulder County, preserved in federal mapping and state and federal district records.

timeline.text: District records document Rambler and Lower Rambler as related but distinct workings within the Boulder County tungsten-mining landscape.

moreHistory: Federal mapping preserves the Rambler Mine locality at approximately 39.947209, -105.508887. The Rambler point is retained for this mine record while the documented Lower Rambler relationship is kept distinct rather than collapsing separate workings into one location.

sourceReferences.title: Colorado Geological Survey MI-04 — Tungsten Mines of Colorado
